title: The Costume Parade
story: Candy rained on Main Street as the Halloween parade closed out October. Four grown-ups marched in costume, each handing out a different sweet from a different-sized bag, and every last piece was gone by the bandstand. Ada wants the counts for Thursday's write-up. "The Gazette prints numbers, not guesses," she says. Who wore which costume, who brought which candy, and how many pieces did each one hand out?

texts: Of the marcher with the caramels and the marcher with the licorice, one dressed as a mermaid and the other dressed as a robot.
The marcher who handed out 100 pieces is either Dot or Hugo.
The marcher with the taffy is either Otis or Mabel.
Hugo did not dress as a pirate.
Hugo handed out more candy than the scarecrow.
Of the marcher with the taffy and the marcher with the licorice, one handed out 50 pieces and the other handed out 125 pieces.
Otis handed out more candy than the mermaid.
The marcher with the caramels handed out exactly 25 more pieces than the pirate.
